انعطفن (form VII)
# اِنْعَطَفْنَ (inʕaṭafna) /in.ʕa.tˤaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْعَطَفَ (inʕaṭafa)
# اِنْعَطِفْنَ (inʕaṭifna) /in.ʕa.tˤif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْعَطَفَ (inʕaṭafa)
